name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.79: fixes product price/name/image edits not reaching machines. handleUpdateProduct did not bump configVersion for machines displaying the product, so a change stayed hidden behind the config 304 and never reached the kiosk (seen first on fridge basket prices, but it affected coil planograms too). A product change now re-touches configVersion on every machine showing that product, as a fridge basket or in a coil planogram, scoped so only affected machines are bumped. Fridge baskets with no priceIsk override correctly inherit the product salePriceIsk, so this makes catalog price changes flow to the shelf-edge tags within one poll. Cumulative over v5.78.
